name: When do I need permit coordination support for my home renovation?

mainEntity.name: When do I need permit coordination support for my home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You typically need permit coordination support for renovations that involve structural changes, electrical work, plumbing modifications, significant HVAC system changes, or additions to your home. Minor cosmetic updates usually don't require permits. If your project alters the building's footprint, safety systems, or occupancy, it's wise to engage permit coordination services to navigate local regulations in areas like Pacifica or San Mateo.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permit coordination support is needed for home renovations involving structural, electrical, plumbing, or significant HVAC changes, or additions. Minor cosmetic work typically does not require it.
